## Purpose
Installation and maintenance utilities for the codecontext plugin. Owns the wiring of the plugin into a host repo — symlinking/copying files, merging Claude hook config, and providing a non-blocking PR creation wrapper.

## Map
- Plugin installation into host repo → `install.sh` · `PLUGIN_ROOT`, `TARGET`, `DOCGEN_SHIM`
- Idempotent hook merge into host `.claude/settings.json` → `merge-settings.mjs` · (default export, invoked by `install.sh` and directly via CLI)
- Non-blocking `gh pr create` wrapper (avoids pre-push hook hangs) → `safe-pr-create.sh`

## Dependencies / collaborators
- `hooks/settings.json` — template of hook entries that `install.sh` and `merge-settings.mjs` read and merge into the host repo
- `docgen/` — `install.sh` shimlinks `tools/docgen → tools/codecontext/docgen` so legacy callers continue to work
- Host repo's `.claude/settings.json` — written/merged by both `install.sh` and `merge-settings.mjs`

## Gotchas
- `install.sh` uses `node` directly (not `npx`) to run `merge-settings.mjs` — Node.js must be on PATH in the install environment.
- `--uninstall` only removes `tools/codecontext`; it intentionally leaves `.claude/settings.json` entries in place (hooks pointing at missing files are no-ops, but cleanup is manual).
- `safe-pr-create.sh` polls every 5s and hard-kills `gh` at `--timeout` seconds (default 180); it writes a temp log via `mktemp` so body heredocs with backticks don't flake the shell parser.
